text.description_html:
Michael Healy MHS22, Dragonfly Door Knocker in Nickel Silver

The 4-1/2 Inch Silver Nickel Dragonfly Door Knocker is the perfect finishing touch to your front door. Dragonflies are symbolic of love and new beginnings, making this the ideal house warming gift or wedding present. The dragonfly in flight door knocker is made from sandcast brass and finished in nickel silver which is a unique finish to Michael Healy Designs. It is created by combining polished nickel with satin highlights that accent this front door knocker's details for a contemporary look. This front door knocker is 4-1/2 inches tall and 6-1/2 inches wide.

Each door knocker is beautifully packed and is signed and dated by the artist, Michael Healy.

Available in 3 finishes:
Nickel Silver Polished Brass and Bronze Oiled Bronze

Features and Specifications of the Dragonfly Front Door Knocker:

  • Material: Sandcast Brass
  • Finish: Nickel Silver
  • Height: 4-1/2
  • Width: 6-1/2"
  • Projection Off Door: 1"
  • Mounting: Surface Mounting
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
